web.brand.subtitle: Certificate manager
web.login.title: Administrator sign-in
web.login.desc: Access via OpenSSH local forward or a reverse proxy. The password is verified locally.
web.login.error: Incorrect password or sign-in is rate limited
web.login.note: Repeated failures trigger temporary rate limiting. Sessions expire after 30 minutes idle, with a 24-hour absolute limit.
web.login.2fa.title: Second-factor verification
web.login.2fa.desc: Your password is verified. Complete sign-in with a registered TOTP code or Passkey.
web.login.2fa.passkey_hint: The browser will ask for a Passkey on your device.
web.dashboard.title: Overview
web.dashboard.empty: No client certificates yet. Issued certificates will appear here.
web.certs.title: Certificates
web.detail.readonly: Currently read-only, or the root helper is unavailable. Use the CLI or ask root to enable the helper.
web.detail.subject: Subject
web.settings.title: Settings
web.settings.general_desc: Theme and language are low-risk interface preferences and can be changed here.
web.settings.theme_desc: The theme is stored only in this browser; it never changes certificates or service configuration.
web.settings.language_desc: Change the interface language; certificate data is unchanged.
web.settings.necap_desc: necap manages passwords, TOTP, Passkeys, recovery codes and policy. Management actions require re-authentication.
web.settings.necap_reauth_desc: Enter your password and a registered TOTP or recovery code. Use Passkey on the sign-in page. Use recovery codes if Passkey-only.
web.settings.necap_totp_uri_hint: Import this otpauth URI into your authenticator, then enter the code.
web.settings.necap_passkey_note: Passkey enrollment requires browser support; deletion is protected by the active policy.
web.settings.about_desc: Software version, source, help and license information.
web.settings.save_confirm_desc: Re-enter the administrator password and confirm this change. Existing session epoch rules still apply after saving.
web.settings.unsaved: You have unsaved settings. Leave this page?
web.settings.js_required: JavaScript is required to save high-risk settings.
web.settings.high_risk_unavailable: Web is not writable or the root helper is unavailable; high-risk settings cannot be changed right now.
web.settings.high_risk_locked: Web is currently read-only; high-risk settings cannot be changed here. Use the backend root command to restore write mode.
web.settings.readonly_warning: Enabling read-only immediately disables Web write mode and all high-risk edits here; only backend root can restore write mode afterward.
web.notice.settings_readonly: Read-only mode enabled; Web writes and high-risk edits are disabled until backend root restores write mode.
web.settings.low_risk_desc: Language and theme are low-risk preferences; use the sidebar controls.
web.settings.high_risk_desc: High-risk settings are read-only and backend-root-only by default.
web.settings.high_risk_enabled: The backend allows Web edits of high-risk settings; Y/N, re-authentication, CSRF and audit are still required.
web.settings.high_risk_disabled: The backend does not allow Web edits of high-risk settings; this page is read-only.
web.settings.allow_high_risk: Allow Web edits of high-risk settings
web.settings.backend_only: adminCNs, passkey and helper-related settings remain backend-only.
web.notice.settings_updated: High-risk settings updated; session epoch rules apply.
web.downloads.title: Downloads
web.downloads.empty: No downloads. ZIP files created by the CLI appear here and expire after 30 minutes by default.
web.new.title: Issue a certificate
web.new.desc: Writes are performed by the root helper. CN allows letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen; a p12 and platform bundles are generated immediately.
web.new.installers_hint: User opt-in; generated only for Windows/Linux/macOS; off by default.
web.error.title: Request could not be completed
web.notice.reissue: Certificate reissued; the old certificate was archived
web.notice.trashed: Certificate moved to the recycle bin; restore it from the CLI with neca trash
web.notice.already: The operation was already completed; nothing was changed
web.app.subtitle: strongSwan IKEv2 client certificates
web.detail.title: Certificate %s
web.login.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts; try again later
